skills.name: General Shop Awareness
skills.summary: exits, first aid, adult rule, PPE
skills.description: Identify emergency exits, fire extinguisher and first aid kit locations. Understand the never-work-alone rule. Know required footwear and clothing standards in the shop.

skills.name: Eye & Hearing Protection
skills.description: Identify which tasks require safety glasses vs. a full face shield. Know when hearing protection is required and how to wear it correctly.

skills.name: Hazard Recognition
skills.description: Recognize and correctly report hazardous conditions. Know the correct escalation chain for safety issues.

skills.name: Battery Handling
skills.description: Demonstrate correct two-handed carry with terminal protection. Safely connect and disconnect a battery using main breaker first. Know correct storage conditions.

skills.name: Battery Charging & Damage
skills.description: Operate an FRC battery charger correctly. Identify a damaged or swollen battery: do not charge, tag, and report to a mentor.

skills.name: Electrical Safety
skills.description: Understand why FRC batteries are dangerous even without motor controllers. Never work on a powered robot without mentor authorization. Identify short circuit risks.

skills.name: Enable/Disable Protocol
skills.description: Demonstrate correct Driver Station enable/disable procedure. Practice the "robot enabled" callout culture. Enforce the clear-the-robot rule — everyone steps back before enable.

skills.name: E-Stop Operation
skills.description: Know when and how to trigger the emergency stop. Understand that an e-stop requires a robot restart before re-enabling.

skills.name: Competition & Pit Safety
skills.description: Know pit safety rules at competition. Demonstrate proper team-lift technique. Identify your team's safety captain and their role.

skills.name: Digital Calipers
skills.description: Zero the calipers correctly. Take accurate inside, outside, and depth measurements. Read both metric and imperial scales.

skills.name: Fastener Identification
skills.description: Identify common bolt head types, nut types, and FRC thread sizes in both imperial and metric.

skills.name: Tape Measure
skills.description: Read a tape measure to 1/32" accuracy. Understand inside vs. outside measurements and hook allowance.

skills.name: Reading Mech. Drawings
skills.description: Read a multi-view mechanical drawing and identify part features from orthographic projections. Interpret dimension annotations.

skills.name: Hex Keys & Allen Wrenches
skills.description: Select the correct hex key size. Apply torque correctly to avoid cam-out and stripped sockets.

skills.name: Combo Wrench & Socket
skills.description: Select the correct wrench or socket size. Use a ratchet and extension correctly.

skills.name: Hand Tapping
skills.description: Select the correct tap for a given hole size and pitch. Use a tap wrench with cutting fluid. Recognize and avoid tap breakage.

skills.name: Thread-Locker & Torque
skills.description: Apply the correct grade of thread-locker for a given application. Develop tactile sense for correct fastener torque.

skills.name: Hand Drill
skills.description: Select the correct drill bit type and size. Set appropriate speed for drilling metal. Secure work before drilling.

skills.name: Drill Press
skills.description: Set up and clamp work on a drill press table. Set the depth stop. Select appropriate speed. Use a center punch first.

skills.name: Bandsaw
skills.description: Select the correct blade for the cut type. Set correct feed rate. Make straight and curved cuts safely.

skills.name: Bench Grinder
skills.description: Select the correct grinding wheel. Set the tool rest to the correct angle and gap. Use with face shield and correct body position.

skills.name: Aluminum Stock
skills.description: Identify common aluminum profiles used in FRC. Make accurate cuts with the bandsaw. Deburr and finish cut edges.

skills.name: Riveting
skills.description: Select the correct blind rivet size. Use a rivet tool correctly. Install a rivet nut for threaded connections in thin material.

skills.name: Sheet Metal Work
skills.description: Lay out a flat pattern for a bent part. Use a brake to make accurate bends. Drill hole patterns from a drawing.

skills.name: Lathe
skills.description: Set up a part in the lathe chuck. Perform a facing cut. Turn a shaft to a specified diameter. Part off a piece safely.

skills.name: Mill
skills.description: Indicate and square stock in a milling vise. Drill and bore holes on-center. Profile edges with an end mill.

skills.name: CNC Router / Plasma Table
skills.description: Set up and fixture material. Load and verify a toolpath file. Run a job safely and inspect the output.

skills.name: Bearing & Shaft Assembly
skills.description: Press a bearing into a bearing block correctly. Install a shaft and secure with appropriate retention. Inspect for smooth rotation.

skills.name: Chain & Sprocket Assembly
skills.description: Install a roller chain on sprockets correctly. Install and orient a master link. Set correct tension and verify alignment.

skills.name: Belt & Pulley Assembly
skills.description: Install an HTD or GT2 belt on pulleys. Set correct tension using the deflection method. Verify pulley alignment.

skills.name: Full Robot Assembly
skills.description: Assemble a complete robot mechanism from drawings without verbal instruction. Coordinate with a partner. Verify assembly against the drawing.

skills.name: Diagnosing Mech. Failures
skills.description: Diagnose a mechanical failure under competition time pressure. Identify root cause vs. symptoms. Execute or direct a repair and verify.

skills.name: Identifying Key Requirements
skills.description: Articulate the functional requirements a mechanism must meet before proposing any design. Distinguish must-have from nice-to-have.

skills.name: COTS Research
skills.description: Find and evaluate COTS parts from REV, WCP, and Andymark. Read datasheets and load CAD models into your assembly.

skills.name: Trade-off Articulation
skills.description: Present two or more design options with explicit trade-offs (cost, weight, lead time, complexity). Articulate which is better and why.

skills.name: Decomposing Game Challenges
skills.description: Read a game manual section and decompose the challenge into a ranked list of mechanism requirements.

skills.name: Sketching with Dimensions
skills.description: Produce a hand sketch of a mechanism idea with labeled dimensions, annotations, and a note on key constraints.

skills.name: Measuring Existing Mechanisms
skills.description: Measure an existing mechanism and record dimensions accurately enough to reproduce it in CAD.

skills.name: Low-Fidelity Prototyping
skills.description: Build a low-fidelity prototype of a mechanism concept using wood, cardboard, or a quick 3D print to test geometry and motion.

skills.name: Success Criteria & Testing
skills.description: Write a clear success criterion before running a prototype test. Record pass/fail results and what was learned.

skills.name: Structured Design Feedback
skills.description: Give feedback on a design that is specific, actionable, and kind. Receive feedback without defensiveness.

skills.name: Simple CAD Part
skills.description: Create a simple single-body part in CAD using extrude, hole, and fillet operations.

skills.name: Simple CAD Assembly
skills.description: Import parts into a CAD assembly and apply mates or joints to fully constrain the model.

skills.name: Tolerances & Fits
skills.description: Apply appropriate tolerances and fits to CAD geometry: clearance holes vs. tapped holes, press fit vs. slip fit.

skills.name: Multi-Part Mechanism in CAD
skills.description: Model a multi-part mechanism in CAD with all joints fully constrained and motion properly represented.

skills.name: Manufacturing Drawings
skills.description: Generate a manufacturing drawing from CAD with correct views, dimensions, tolerances, and a title block.

skills.name: Participating in Design Review
skills.description: Present a design in a formal review. Field technical questions and incorporate feedback into the design.

skills.name: Motor & Gearbox Selection
skills.description: Use a motor torque-speed curve to select a motor and gear ratio for a given mechanism load and speed requirement.

skills.name: DFM
skills.description: Review a design and identify features that cannot be made with the team's available tools. Propose alternatives.

skills.name: DFA
skills.description: Review a design for assembly sequence, fastener access, and part count. Propose simplifications.

skills.name: Leading a Design Review
skills.description: Facilitate a design review for another student's mechanism. Synthesize feedback and help the designer prioritize changes.

skills.name: Failure Mode Identification
skills.description: List the likely failure modes for a mechanism design and propose design changes to reduce risk.

skills.name: Full Mechanism CAD to Release
skills.description: Complete a full mechanism design through CAD release: drawings, BOM, and version-controlled files.

skills.name: Notebook Documentation
skills.description: Write a complete engineering notebook section for a mechanism covering requirements, design decisions, prototyping, and test results.

skills.name: Mentor a Newer Student
skills.description: Guide a newer student through a complete design-prototype-test cycle, adjusting your coaching style to their level.

skills.name: Basic Circuits
skills.description: Explain voltage, current, and resistance. Apply Ohm's law to simple series and parallel circuits.

skills.name: Wire Identification
skills.summary: gauge, color conventions, stranded vs solid
skills.description: Identify wire gauge by sight and feel. Know FRC color conventions and when to use stranded vs. solid wire.

skills.name: Wire Stripping
skills.description: Strip wire to the correct length without nicking the conductors. Know the correct strip length for each connector type.

skills.name: Anderson PowerPole Assembly
skills.description: Crimp a PowerPole contact correctly. Assemble the housing with correct polarity. Inspect for pull-out strength.

skills.name: Molex SL Crimping
skills.description: Crimp a Molex SL pin correctly. Seat the pin in the housing until it latches. Inspect for correct insertion.

skills.name: DuPont (PWM) Crimping
skills.description: Crimp a DuPont pin correctly. Assemble a PWM connector with correct pin order and strain relief.

skills.name: Ring Terminals
skills.summary: lug size, die selection, heat shrink
skills.description: Select the correct ring terminal lug size. Crimp with the correct die. Apply heat shrink for strain relief.

skills.name: Ferrule Crimping
skills.description: Select the correct ferrule size for the wire gauge. Set the crimping tool correctly. Inspect for complete crimp.

skills.name: Hydraulic Crimping
skills.summary: large gauge cable, die, pull test
skills.description: Crimp a large-gauge battery cable lug using a hydraulic crimper. Select the correct die. Perform a pull test.

skills.name: FRC Control System Overview
skills.description: Identify and explain the function of each component in the FRC control system: RoboRIO, PDP/PDH, radio, main breaker, and motor controllers.

skills.name: Main Breaker & Fuse Sizing
skills.description: Select the correct fuse or breaker for a given motor circuit. Know PDP/PDH slot current ratings.

skills.name: Multimeter Use
skills.description: Use a multimeter to measure voltage, check continuity, and measure resistance. Diagnose an open or short circuit.

skills.name: Motor Controller Wiring
skills.description: Wire a Talon FX or SPARK MAX correctly: power leads to PDP/PDH, signal leads to RoboRIO or CAN bus. Verify polarity.

skills.name: Main Power Fasteners
skills.summary: battery terminals, main breaker, PDP lugs
skills.description: Torque battery terminal bolts, main breaker connections, and PDP/PDH lugs to spec. Know anti-arc precautions.

skills.name: CAN Bus Wiring
skills.description: Wire a CAN bus daisy chain with correct polarity. Install termination resistors. Assign device IDs.

skills.name: PWM & Digital I/O Wiring
skills.description: Wire a PWM or digital I/O signal correctly: signal, ground, and power in the correct orientation on the RoboRIO.

skills.name: Limit Switch Wiring
skills.description: Wire a limit switch in NO or NC configuration. Understand pull-up resistors. Mount for reliable actuation.

skills.name: Control System Mounting
skills.description: Mount RoboRIO, PDP/PDH, and radio with appropriate standoffs and vibration-isolating grommets.

skills.name: Sensor Mounting
skills.summary: limit switches, beam breaks — brackets, adjustability
skills.description: Mount sensors with brackets that allow adjustment. Ensure reliable actuation or alignment across the robot's range of motion.

skills.name: Wiring Diagrams
skills.description: Read and create an FRC wiring diagram using standard symbols, wire labels, and a revision block.

skills.name: Wiring Documentation
skills.description: Produce a complete wiring documentation package: diagram, wire BOM, and revision-controlled files.

skills.name: Troubleshoot with Multimeter
skills.description: Use a multimeter to trace a wiring fault on a live robot. Identify voltage drop across a connection.

skills.name: Power Budget & Breaker Sizing
skills.description: Build a power budget for the robot. Verify that each circuit's breaker matches the motor stall current.

skills.name: Diagnose Brownouts & CAN Faults
skills.description: Diagnose a brownout or CAN bus fault on a robot under competition time pressure. Identify and fix the root cause.

skills.name: Java Syntax Fundamentals
skills.description: Write Java programs using variables, primitive types, conditionals, loops, and methods.

skills.name: Object-Oriented Concepts
skills.description: Implement classes with inheritance and interfaces. Understand encapsulation and polymorphism.

skills.name: Git Basics
skills.description: Clone a repo, commit changes with a useful message, push to remote, pull updates, and create a branch.

skills.name: VS Code & WPILib Setup
skills.description: Install WPILib and the VS Code extension. Create a new FRC robot project and add vendordeps.

skills.name: Deploy Code to Robot
skills.description: Build and deploy robot code successfully. Connect the Driver Station and read the RoboRIO log on a failure.

skills.name: Git Collaboration
skills.description: Open a pull request, resolve a merge conflict, and review a teammate's code before merging.

skills.name: Command-Based Architecture
skills.description: Implement a subsystem and command using the WPILib command-based framework. Wire a trigger to a command.

skills.name: Subsystem State Machines
skills.summary: state enums, transition methods, periodic dispatch
skills.description: Model a subsystem as an explicit state machine using an enum. Implement transition methods and periodic dispatch.

skills.name: Robot Superstructure Design
skills.description: Design a superstructure class that coordinates multiple subsystems. Compare command-group vs. state-machine approaches at the robot level.

skills.name: CTRE Motor Control
skills.description: Configure a TalonFX using the CTRE API. Read position and velocity via StatusSignals.

skills.name: REV Motor Control
skills.description: Configure a SPARK MAX or SPARK Flex using the REV API. Set up a follower motor.

skills.name: CTRE Sensor Reading
skills.description: Read integrated encoder position and velocity from a TalonFX via StatusSignals. Read heading from a Pigeon 2.

skills.name: REV Sensor Reading
skills.summary: built-in encoder, absolute encoder via SPARK
skills.description: Read encoder position and velocity from a SPARK MAX. Configure and read an absolute encoder through the SPARK.

skills.name: Basic Closed-Loop Control
skills.description: Implement a PID controller on a mechanism. Tune kP, kI, kD by observation. Add a feedforward term.

skills.name: On-Robot PID
skills.description: Configure PID running on the motor controller hardware rather than the RoboRIO. Understand the trade-offs.

skills.name: Simulation
skills.summary: WPILib sim, physics sim, sim vs. real
skills.description: Run robot code in WPILib simulation. Implement a physics sim for a mechanism. Compare sim and real behavior.

skills.name: Swerve Drive Fundamentals
skills.description: Implement swerve drive kinematics and odometry. Enable field-relative control using a gyro.

skills.name: Simple Autonomous
skills.description: Write a simple autonomous routine using a command group. Expose multiple auto options via SendableChooser.

skills.name: Choreo Basics
skills.description: Create a trajectory in Choreo. Load and follow it in robot code using ChoreoTrajectory.

skills.name: Choreo Advanced
skills.description: Add event markers to a Choreo path. Split trajectories for multi-piece autos. Mirror paths for alliance color.

skills.name: Auto Routine Architecture
skills.summary: multiple paths, dynamic selection, state handoff
skills.description: Build a complete auto system with multiple paths, dynamic selection, and clean state handoff into teleop.

skills.name: DogLog Setup & Logging
skills.summary: log fields, periodic logging, log file
skills.description: Integrate DogLog into a robot project. Log subsystem state and sensor values every loop. Read the log file.

skills.name: AdvantageKit Integration
skills.description: Refactor a subsystem to use AdvantageKit IO layers. Implement logged inputs. Replay a match log.

skills.name: AdvantageScope Analysis
skills.summary: log import, signal graphing, 3D field view
skills.description: Import a log into AdvantageScope. Graph signals over time. View robot pose on the 3D field.

skills.name: Elastic Dashboard
skills.description: Configure an Elastic dashboard with relevant widgets. Subscribe to NetworkTables values from robot code.

skills.name: Telemetry-Driven Debugging
skills.summary: reproduce a match bug from a log
skills.description: Take a match log and reproduce a specific bug by correlating software state with electrical and mechanical events.

skills.name: PhotonVision Basics
skills.description: Configure a camera in PhotonVision. Set up an AprilTag pipeline. Apply latency compensation.

skills.name: Pose Estimation
skills.description: Implement PhotonPoseEstimator in robot code. Fuse multiple camera estimates. Visualize pose on Field2d.

skills.name: Vision-Assisted Alignment
skills.description: Implement auto-align to a field target using vision. Filter low-confidence estimates with trust thresholds.

skills.name: Competition Code Readiness
skills.summary: pre-match checklist, NT4 alerts, fault monitoring
skills.description: Add pre-match alert checks, fault monitoring, and disable/enable state handling to competition code.

skills.name: Architecture Trade-off Judgment
skills.summary: propose & defend approach for a new mechanism
skills.description: Read a codebase, identify which architectural pattern was used and why, then write a design doc proposing an approach for a new mechanism.

skills.name: Code Standards & Documentation
skills.description: Write inline docs and a subsystem README meeting team standards. Produce an architecture diagram.

skills.name: Mentor a Newer Student
skills.description: Guide a newer student through a complete feature: scoping, implementation, pull request, code review, and merge.

skills.name: Game Manual Reading
skills.description: Navigate the game manual structure. Locate scoring rules, penalty rules, and game-specific sections quickly.

skills.name: Scoring System Mastery
skills.description: State all point values, ranking point conditions, coopertition mechanics, and tie-breaker criteria from memory.

skills.name: Foul & Penalty Rules
skills.summary: GP vs. technical fouls, card conditions
skills.description: Identify what triggers a GP foul vs. a technical foul. Know red and yellow card conditions.

skills.name: Ranking & Alliance Selection
skills.description: Explain the ranking criteria, alliance selection order, and backup robot rules.

skills.name: Question Box Protocol
skills.summary: when to go, how to phrase, documentation
skills.description: Know when a score challenge is worth pursuing. Phrase a question box inquiry correctly. Document the outcome.

skills.name: Field Logistics Fundamentals
skills.description: Identify field zones, alliance station numbering, and the field reset flow. Know referee positions.

skills.name: Driver Station Setup
skills.summary: laptop, tether vs. comp mode, FMS checklist
skills.description: Set up the driver station laptop correctly. Switch between tether and competition mode. Run the pre-match FMS checklist.

skills.name: Robot Staging & Setup
skills.description: Place the robot on the correct start tile. Load game piece preloads. Verify bumper legality before queuing.

skills.name: In-Queue Procedures
skills.description: Know the queue timing. Execute a battery swap in queue. Verify radio light pattern before entering the field.

skills.name: Robot Removal
skills.description: Safely power down and carry the robot off the field. Assess damage before handing off to pit crew.

skills.name: Cart & Pit Logistics
skills.description: Park the cart in the correct zone. Maintain cable management on the cart. Know tool bag contents.

skills.name: Pre-Match System Check
skills.summary: confirm pit crew checklist, battery, radio
skills.description: Verify the pit crew's pre-match checklist is complete. Confirm battery voltage, radio lights, and DS connection.

skills.name: Bumper Visual Check
skills.description: Verify bumper number legibility, retention, gap and height compliance, and no fabric tears.

skills.name: Electrical Visual Check
skills.description: Check Anderson connector seating, breaker status, CAN fault lights, and no exposed wiring.

skills.name: Mechanical Visual Check
skills.description: Check for loose fasteners, chain/belt tension, game piece path clearance, and bumper-to-frame contact.

skills.name: Queue Investigation
skills.description: Perform a systematic full-robot sweep in queue. Know the threshold for escalating an issue to pit crew vs. playing.

skills.name: Between-Match Repair Triage
skills.summary: fix vs. defer vs. pull, precise comms
skills.description: Assess damage severity after a match. Decide fix vs. defer vs. pull robot. Communicate precisely to pit crew.

skills.name: Live Score Tracking
skills.description: Read the scoring display live. Identify potential discrepancies. Track ranking point progress during a match.

skills.name: Foul & Event Logging
skills.description: Record foul triggers, timing of key events, and referee interactions during a match.

skills.name: Cycle Tracking
skills.description: Count completed cycles for one robot during a match. Note defensive interference and estimate opponent cycle rate.

skills.name: Score Challenge Assessment
skills.description: Identify a scoring discrepancy worth challenging. Build a concise challenge argument from logged data.

skills.name: Opponent Weakness ID
skills.description: Identify an opponent's weakness from in-match observation. Note defensive opportunities.

skills.name: Post-Match Debrief
skills.summary: robot vs. strategy vs. driver issues
skills.description: Run a structured post-match debrief. Separate robot issues from strategy issues from driver issues. Produce actionable next steps.

skills.name: Match Preparation Routine
skills.summary: strategy card, alliance comms, backup plans
skills.description: Complete a full pre-match preparation: strategy card, alliance communication, and backup plans for common failure modes.

skills.name: Alliance Strategy Coordination
skills.description: Negotiate auto and teleop roles with alliance partners. Identify the weakest alliance link and adapt strategy to compensate.

skills.name: Competition Day Leadership
skills.description: Manage energy and focus across a full event day. Communicate with pit crew under time pressure. Model gracious professionalism in high-stakes moments.

skills.name: Field & Game Piece Familiarization
skills.summary: elements, zones, auto vs. teleop scoring
skills.description: Identify all physical field elements, game piece types, and legal interaction zones. Distinguish auto vs. teleop scoring.

skills.name: Scoring System Mastery
skills.description: State all point values, ranking point conditions, coopertition mechanics, and tie-breaker criteria.

skills.name: Foul & Penalty Recognition
skills.description: Recognize fouls from the stands. Distinguish GP from technical fouls. Understand what referees are watching for.

skills.name: Tally Scouting Basics
skills.description: Complete a match scouting form for auto, teleop, and endgame using paper or a scouting app.

skills.name: Cycle Counting
skills.summary: defining a cycle, counting under pressure
skills.description: Define a complete cycle for the current game. Count cycles accurately under match pressure.

skills.name: Defensive & Foul Logging
skills.description: Record defensive actions, fouls committed, fouls drawn, and their impact on match outcome.

skills.name: Auto Routine Documentation
skills.description: Record a robot's starting position, auto game piece scores, mobility bonus, and consistency across matches.

skills.name: Robot Capability Flags
skills.summary: climb type, intake, game piece handling
skills.description: Note a robot's observed capabilities: climb type, floor vs. source intake, game piece handling, under-stage ability.

skills.name: Quantitative Data Entry
skills.description: Enter match data accurately into the team's scouting system. Flag uncertain observations. Handle no-shows and surrogates.

skills.name: Qualitative Match Scouting
skills.description: Assigned to a single robot: write descriptive notes on strategy, adaptation, driver skill, mechanism reliability, and match-to-match behavioral patterns. Terminal skill.

skills.name: Pit Scouting Preparation
skills.description: Generate a pit scouting form. Know which questions are answerable by observation alone vs. requiring an interview.

skills.name: Pit Interview Technique
skills.description: Use open and closed questions effectively. Build rapport quickly. Know when to probe vs. move on.

skills.name: Robot Observation in Pit
skills.description: Observe a robot in the pit: drivetrain type, bumper construction, game piece mechanisms, notable COTS vs. custom features.

skills.name: Pit Scouting Synthesis
skills.description: Combine interview data with observation. Flag discrepancies between what a team claims and what their robot shows.

skills.name: Basic Data Analysis
skills.description: Compute averages, identify outliers, assess consistency, and reason about small sample size risk.

skills.name: Comparative Robot Ranking
skills.summary: pick list from raw data, weighting criteria
skills.description: Build a simple pick list from scouted data. Weight criteria by game relevance.

skills.name: OPR & EPA Concepts
skills.summary: what they measure, when to trust vs. override
skills.description: Explain what OPR and EPA measure and where they come from. Know when to trust vs. override with observational data.

skills.name: Scouting System Validation
skills.description: Cross-check scouted data against match scores. Identify scouts with systematic errors.

skills.name: Statbotics & TBA Literacy
skills.description: Read a Statbotics or TBA event page. Understand component OPR. Filter by week, event, and year.

skills.name: Alliance Selection Analysis
skills.summary: pick list, complementary robots, anticipating picks
skills.description: Build a ranked pick list with rationale. Identify complementary vs. redundant robots. Anticipate other alliances' picks.

skills.name: Match Strategy Reports
skills.description: Produce a pre-match brief for the drive team: opponent tendencies, foul risks, auto conflicts, defensive opportunities.

skills.name: Scouting System Design
skills.description: Design or improve a data collection form. Define required fields. Balance comprehensiveness vs. scout cognitive load.

skills.name: Alliance Communication
skills.summary: present pick list, advocate with data
skills.description: Present pick list recommendations clearly to drive coach and strategy lead. Advocate for a position with data.

skills.name: Mentor a New Scout
skills.description: Teach observation skills, calibrate cycle counting, review data quality, and build team scouting culture.

skills.name: Robot Systems Overview
skills.description: Explain each subsystem's purpose, how they interact, and the key failure modes to watch for.

skills.name: Mechanical Systems Familiarity
skills.description: Navigate the as-built mechanical layout: drivetrain, game mechanism linkages, fastener locations, wear points, and adjustment points.

skills.name: Electrical Systems Familiarity
skills.summary: wiring diagram, breaker map, CAN order
skills.description: Navigate the as-built wiring diagram, breaker map, CAN bus order, and motor controller and sensor locations.

skills.name: Software Systems Familiarity
skills.description: Know the deployed branch and version, what each button and trigger does, current auto options, and known software limitations.

skills.name: Battery Tracking
skills.description: Maintain the battery numbering system and charge log. Rotate batteries correctly. Identify degraded batteries.

skills.name: Pre-Match Checklist Execution
skills.summary: follow exactly, record pass/fail, flag marginal
skills.description: Follow the pre-match checklist exactly as written. Record pass/fail for each item. Flag marginal items. Never skip steps under time pressure.

skills.name: Fastener Inspection & Tightening
skills.description: Perform a systematic fastener check. Reapply thread-locker where needed. Identify stripped threads.

skills.name: Drive System Maintenance
skills.summary: chain/belt tension, wheel condition, module alignment
skills.description: Check and adjust chain/belt tension. Assess wheel condition. Verify swerve module alignment.

skills.name: Game Mechanism Inspection
skills.summary: linkage geometry, bearing condition, path clearance
skills.description: Check linkage geometry, sprocket/pulley alignment, bearing condition, and game piece path clearance.

skills.name: Drivetrain Repair
skills.description: Swap a wheel or swerve module. Replace a chain or belt. Reassemble and verify before returning to service.

skills.name: Game Mechanism Repair
skills.description: Replace worn bearings, re-time linkages, and replace sprockets or pulleys. Restore game piece path clearance.

skills.name: Electrical Repair
skills.summary: reseat connectors, replace controller, CAN isolation
skills.description: Reseat connectors, replace a motor controller, isolate a CAN bus fault, replace a sensor, re-route damaged wiring.

skills.name: Timed Repair Execution
skills.summary: within match cycle time, parallel tasking
skills.description: Complete a known repair within match cycle time. Parallel task with a partner. Hand off cleanly to drive team.

skills.name: Pit Setup & Layout
skills.summary: furniture, tool org, robot stand, safety
skills.description: Arrange pit furniture and tools. Place the robot stand. Manage cables. Comply with pit safety rules.

skills.name: Tool & Consumables Inventory
skills.summary: know location, return after use, flag missing
skills.description: Know where every tool is. Return tools after use. Flag missing or damaged tools immediately.

skills.name: Spare Parts Organization
skills.summary: labeled bins, quantities, log consumed spares
skills.description: Maintain labeled spare parts bins with known quantities. Log consumed spares so restock is triggered.

skills.name: Between-Match Pit Flow
skills.summary: receive robot, assess, prioritize, battery swap
skills.description: Receive the robot from drive team, immediately assess damage, prioritize repairs, swap the battery, and time the drive team handoff.

skills.name: Spare Parts List Development
skills.description: Identify every consumable and failure-prone component on the robot. Determine quantities needed per event.

skills.name: Pit Supplies Packing
skills.summary: tools, consumables, electronics — verified against list
skills.description: Pack tools, consumables, safety gear, and electronics spares against a master list before departure.

skills.name: Pre-Match Checklist Development
skills.description: Identify every system needing pre-match verification. Write steps precisely enough for any trained student. Validate with a test run.

skills.name: Event Readiness Review
skills.description: Confirm robot, pit supplies, spare parts, batteries, and documentation are all accounted for before leaving for the event.

skills.name: FRC Inspection Familiarity
skills.description: Know the full FRC inspection checklist: weight, bumper, electrical, software, and mechanical criteria.

skills.name: Common Inspection Failures
skills.description: Know what gets flagged most often. Run a self-inspection routine before presenting to an inspector.

skills.name: Bumper Compliance
skills.description: Verify bumper number placement, height and gap rules, fabric condition, and retention system.

skills.name: Inspection Communication
skills.description: Present the robot confidently to an inspector. Know when to ask for clarification vs. accept a ruling. Understand the re-inspection request process.

skills.name: Inspection Strategy
skills.description: Time inspection early in the event. Know which items to verify last. Maintain an inspection result log across events.

skills.name: Robot Presentation Basics
skills.description: Explain what the robot does clearly to a non-technical visitor. Identify the most compelling aspects of the design.

skills.name: Pit Scout Interaction
skills.summary: answer accurately, direct to notable features
skills.description: Answer pit scout questions accurately and completely. Neither oversell nor undersell capabilities. Direct scouts to notable robot features.

skills.name: Judge Interaction
skills.summary: recognize judge, present robot & team story
skills.description: Recognize a judge visiting the pit. Present the robot and team story concisely. Connect technical work to team values.

skills.name: Awards Presentation Support
skills.summary: know target awards, coach newer members
skills.description: Know which awards the team is pursuing and what judges look for. Coach newer members on speaking to judges.

skills.name: Pit Crew Lead Readiness
skills.description: Own the full between-match cycle independently. Make repair prioritization calls. Manage pit crew workload. Communicate status to drive coach.

skills.name: Post-Event Robot Assessment
skills.description: Document wear, damage, and near-misses after an event. Feed findings into pre-season rebuild and spare parts planning.

skills.name: Mentor a New Pit Crew Member
skills.description: Teach checklist discipline, repair technique, and pit communication skills to a newer student.

skills.name: Self-Assessment & Goal Setting
skills.description: Honestly identify strengths and growth areas. Set specific short-term goals and revisit them regularly.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.summary: full attention, clarifying questions, reflecting back
skills.description: Give full attention in a conversation. Ask clarifying questions. Reflect back what you heard before responding.

skills.name: Clear Written Communication
skills.description: Write emails and messages that are unambiguous and appropriately concise. Use professional tone in external communications.

skills.name: Clear Verbal Communication
skills.description: Explain technical work clearly to a non-technical audience. Give structured updates in meetings. Speak confidently in public.

skills.name: Constructive Feedback
skills.summary: specific, actionable, kind — receiving without defensiveness
skills.description: Give feedback that is specific, actionable, and kind. Receive feedback without defensiveness. Distinguish feedback on work from feedback on person.

skills.name: Meeting Facilitation
skills.summary: agenda, on-track, quieter voices, action items
skills.description: Set an agenda. Keep discussion on track. Ensure quieter voices are heard. Close with clear action items and owners.

skills.name: Task Breakdown & Delegation
skills.summary: decompose, match to skills, follow up
skills.description: Decompose a goal into concrete tasks. Match tasks to people's skills and availability. Follow up without micromanaging.

skills.name: Project Tracking
skills.summary: shared record of in-progress, blocked, done
skills.description: Maintain a shared record of what is in progress, what is blocked, and what is done — tool-agnostic.

skills.name: Conflict Navigation
skills.summary: source of disagreement, common ground, escalation
skills.description: Identify the source of a disagreement. Find common ground. Know when to escalate to a mentor vs. resolve within the team.

skills.name: Inclusive Team Culture
skills.summary: noticing disengagement, creating entry points, modeling GP
skills.description: Notice when students are disengaged or excluded. Actively create entry points for new members. Model gracious professionalism visibly.

skills.name: Leading Under Pressure
skills.summary: composure, deciding with incomplete info, owning mistakes
skills.description: Maintain composure during build crunch or competition stress. Make decisions with incomplete information. Own mistakes quickly.

skills.name: Mentorship Fundamentals
skills.description: Understand the difference between teaching, coaching, and directing. Choose the right mode for the situation and person.

skills.name: Teaching a Skill
skills.description: Break a skill into learnable steps. Check for understanding rather than just completion. Adjust your explanation when the first approach doesn't land.

skills.name: Supporting a Struggling Student
skills.summary: recognize stuck, ask good questions, know when to escalate
skills.description: Recognize when someone is stuck or discouraged. Ask good questions rather than jumping to solutions. Know when to involve a mentor.

skills.name: Owning a Mentoring Relationship
skills.description: Take ongoing responsibility for a newer student's growth across a season. Track their skill tree progress. Celebrate milestones and advocate for opportunities.

skills.name: Robot & Team Presentation
skills.summary: engaging demo, adapt for audience, handle questions
skills.description: Deliver a clear, engaging robot demo to a public audience. Adapt depth and vocabulary for age and background. Handle unexpected questions.

skills.name: Outreach Event Execution
skills.description: Manage logistics for a public-facing outreach event: setup and breakdown, managing visitors, representing the team professionally.

skills.name: FLL & Feeder School Support
skills.summary: coach middle school students, support without doing the work
skills.description: Work effectively with middle school students. Adapt coaching style for younger learners. Support FLL design and strategy without doing the work for them.

skills.name: FLL Mentorship
skills.description: Take ongoing responsibility for an FLL team across a season. Manage the school relationship. Prepare the team for competition. Terminal skill.

skills.name: New Outreach Program Development
skills.description: Identify a community need, propose a program structure, pilot and evaluate it, and document for repeatability. Terminal skill.

skills.name: Impact Award Contribution
skills.summary: understand criteria, contribute to submission — terminal
skills.description: Understand what the Impact Award evaluates. Contribute to the team's submission. Present the outreach story to judges. Terminal skill.

skills.name: Sponsor Communication Basics
skills.description: Write a professional sponsor outreach or thank-you email. Understand what sponsors want to see from a team.

skills.name: Sponsor Relationship Maintenance
skills.description: Send proactive updates to sponsors. Recognize sponsors at events. Fulfill recognition commitments before seeking new sponsors.

skills.name: Fundraising Participation
skills.summary: support mentor-led efforts, understand grant structures
skills.description: Support mentor-led fundraising. Understand grant structures and timelines. Contribute to a grant application.

skills.name: Social Media & Public Presence
skills.description: Create content that accurately represents the team. Maintain a professional tone. Document events and shop work with photos and video.

skills.name: External Representation
skills.summary: sponsor, community partner, or media — on-message
skills.description: Speak confidently about the team to a sponsor, community partner, or media contact. Stay on-message, accurate, and appropriately enthusiastic.

skills.name: Leadership Reflection Practice
skills.description: Reflect regularly on your own leadership: what worked, what didn't, what you'd do differently. Seek feedback proactively rather than waiting for it.

skills.name: Developing Other Leaders
skills.summary: identify potential, stretch opportunities, coach through difficulty
skills.description: Identify leadership potential in others. Create stretch opportunities. Coach them through difficulty rather than rescuing them.

skills.name: Team Culture Stewardship
skills.description: Actively shape team norms and traditions. Ensure the team's values are visible in how members treat each other, not just what they build.
